verdict.rationale: Consensus supports literature review synthesis with citations, PICO extraction, study design classification, and 'Deep Searches' producing more comprehensive lit reviews, which implies structured output, but there is no explicit evidence of a formatted report with distinct sections, tables, and a shareable summary artifact for stakeholders. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of report formatting/sections/tables, export/share functionality, and any hands-on example of a generated report shared with stakeholders.
